reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Thermocyr, Thanks to Benjamin. What an amazing guy! For context my furnace stopped working a day before Christmas Eve late in the night due to burning smell from vents ( burned components ). So I slept through the cold and woke up to 13 degrees in the house. Tried calling places and everyone was on voicemail with no callbacks due to Christmas Eve. ThermoCyr called back 30 mins later. Benjamin was on the line and he said that he is the only one working during holidays and is busy with other jobs but can make room for me at 5PM. We were in touch and he informed me that he might be a little late but assured me that he hadn't forgotten about me. He arrived and quickly went to the basement to start diagnosing and working on the issue. He was very kind, professional, honest, respectful and quick. He accidentally burned my blower motor while testing and admitted his fault. The blower motor was replaced free of charge. The price for the repair was very reasonable and the job was finished in an hour. Benjamin provided one of the best services I have ever received and that too in an emergency as the next day everything was closed for Christmas. And due to this experience, I would like to recommend ThermoCyr for furnace and heating related issues. Thank you!

When I had an issue with my mini-split AC making noise I called around for a technician. Was told over the phone if I wasn't an existing client they couldn't send out a repair technician. I guess they don't service our brand. We decided to scrap the AC unit and purchase a new one. Their pricing was in line with competitors but we opted for a Daikin brand with Air Technico instead.

In short: I am very pleased with the work performed by the team at Thermocyr in upgrading my home HVAC systems. There service and work were excellent. I am pleasantly surprised at how much warmer and quieter the new system is compared to the old. Not to mention they are more efficient then my old units. I am looking forward to seeing how well the cooling works this summer.

I highly recommend Thermocyr to anyone looking to upgrade their home heating / cooling systems.

Some details: Thermocyr replaced my 23 year old heat pump with a high efficiency unit, along with a new electric furnace replacing a very old oil furnace. They also removed my oil tank without fuss. Pricing was fair and in-line with other contractors, but they took the time to meet with me multiple times to clarify the process and answer my questions, which was greatly appreciated.

My installation was complicated by my desire to burn off my heating oil ($$) and not placing my comfort at risk. To support this, they installed a temporary electric furnace to use once I had burned off my heating oil. This worked seamlessly and allowed for the removal and installation work to continue once I was ready. For a small addition fee they installed an electrical sub-panel as my main panel was full, as additional breakers were needed for my new electric furnace.

NOTE: The Heat-pump and electric furnace are paired units that act in unison to provide seamless heating and cooling.

Thermocyr is registered with 2 Quebec Government rebate programs "Subvention Logis Vert" and "Subvention Chauffez Vert". Thermocyr will advise you as to your eligibility. I have applied to both programs, and I am receiving $4000 in home grants.

We have had nothing but amazing service from Thermocyr, we have dealt with them for the last 10 years and they are always quick and efficient with their service calls. The last time we called them it was because our air conditioning wasn’t working and it was one of the hottest days of the year….and we were boiling hot! Within minutes of coming into the house inspecting the system/ pump they diagnosed the problem and had it fixed within the hour. Highly recommended this company.
Thermocyr was subcontracted to do the HVAC of our new build. They were extremely helpful with the specific things we wanted to do regarding zones & thermostat models.
